assessment.subject: Stable lock and filesystem boundary
assessment.detail: Creates an empty lock once with exclusive creation and validates existing lock without truncating, replacing, or unlinking it. Rejects symlink, hardlink, non-regular, nonempty, wrong-owner/mode and changed-name inode. Existing flock coordination survives auth.json atomic rotation.

assessment.subject: Access-only credential and health boundary
assessment.detail: Health check requires the prepublished lock and the exact access-only auth JSON shape. No refresh credential, network call, lock replacement or lease publication is added to this check. Structural readiness does not prove OAuth validity, provider availability or completed semantic retention.

assessment.subject: Unchanged lease path creates or checks lock
assessment.detail: Lock preparation runs before the unchanged-auth early return; auth publication retains the existing atomic file replacement and directory fsync.

assessment.subject: Mount and dependency scope
assessment.detail: Consumer credential directory remains read-only; only auth.lock is a separate read-write file bind with create_host_path=false. Publisher deployments use structural lease health and service_healthy dependency; isolated prepublished Telegram manifest requires preparation before creation.

assessment.subject: Isolated preparer delta
assessment.detail: New empty lock is created in the existing fresh private directory and remains separate from five sealed inputs. The two reported positive-path failures are at the pre-existing missing signature_verifier call on line 197, before this new line. This review does not assert that the complete preparer API path passes.
